snapshot: Peerless Fence Group is a residential fencing installation company headquartered in West Chicago, IL, operating across Chicagoland, IL, WI, IN, and OH. They are a Home Depot Pro contractor partner — HD generates leads that Peerless sales reps convert into fence installation jobs. The core operational bottleneck is manual cross-referencing between three systems (HD Portal, Salesforce, and ComputerEase) for every new order: verifying contracts, entering jobs, and ensuring compliance — all done today by a single operations manager (Ashley Salerno).
industry: Specialty residential contractor (fencing installation — Home Depot Pro partner)

phase1.label: Connected
phase1.headline: HD Portal, Salesforce, and ComputerEase talk to each other automatically
phase1.body: Every new HD order triggers automatic field validation, contract download, and job creation in ComputerEase — eliminating the 45-90 minutes Ashley spends manually cross-referencing systems for every new job.

phase2.label: Automated
phase2.headline: Compliance and corrections run without human intervention
phase2.body: Mismatch alerts fire in real time as soon as an order arrives. Salesforce corrections sync back to HD Portal automatically. No manual follow-up, no re-entry, no compliance backlog accumulating in Ashley's queue.

phase3.label: Agentic
phase3.headline: AI monitors job cycle times, contract quality, and margin trends
phase3.body: With clean data flowing across all three systems, AI agents can score contract compliance patterns per sales rep, flag at-risk installs before customer complaints arrive, and surface seasonal demand signals from lead volume trends for proactive operations planning.
